---
title: "Stationary calibration and Markov augmentation for Adam-type adaptive MCMC"
author:
  - name: "Jordan Simbananiye"
    affiliations:
      - name: "University College London (UCL) - CCMI CDT"
date: last-modified
abstract: |
  Adam-type adaptation replaces an ordinary stochastic-approximation innovation
  by a normalised function of fixed-gain first- and second-moment memories.
  We identify the stationary field under Markov innovations and its covariance
  correction at Robbins--Monro roots. A finite-dimensional Markov augmentation
  admits a stationary law under moment assumptions. Under stronger coupling
  and regularity conditions, geometric Wasserstein contraction of the driver
  lifts to the augmented process. We derive one-step parameter perturbation
  bounds, invariant-law regularity and a restricted Lipschitz-space Poisson
  estimate, distinguishing the latter's additional operator assumption.
  The resulting estimates specify the ingredients for a controlled-Markov
  ODE approximation; no adaptive ODE-tracking theorem is asserted.
